heroHeadline: DeepSeek and Huawei Announce AI Software Partnership as Tau Chip Rollout Accelerates
heroSubtitle: October 2, 2026 — DeepSeek and Huawei announced a partnership to develop AI software, while Huawei steps up its Tau chip rollout, underscoring China's push to reduce reliance on US chipmakers.
